objective: Prepare an evidence-backed architecture/precision discussion and minimize the work between selecting a design and starting long QAT.
scope: Complete backlog reconciliation with evidence and dependencies
Architecture/precision-dependent features: evidence, cost analysis and preparation only
Directly related bounded follow-ups after primary readiness
reserved_for_user: Architecture selection or architecture comparison experiments
Precision or weight representation changes and comparison sweeps
Final candidate commitment and major long-QAT allocation
acceptance: Every canonical backlog item reconciled or explicitly marked unavailable with evidence
Feature map distinguishes general hypotheses from demonstrated current-candidate effects
Selection-relevant opportunities have actionable tests, evidence, costs and implementation status
Actual fixed-candidate training/resume/export/native-evaluation path exercised; design-dependent gaps explicit
Useful artifacts preserved, owned processes released, storage inventoried
No universal early-pruning or cross-design transfer claims from inconclusive diagnostics

limits.duration: Sustained work authorized to readiness; prior proposed16h was unconfirmed, not a mandatory spend or hard cap
limits.compute: One coordinated local RTX5080 GPU lane; preserve paid checkpoints and held-out partitions
limits.followups: Only bounded developments directly supporting design or QAT readiness; stop when useful authorized work is exhausted

important_current_detail: Latest modern success is per-output-row scale-only adaptation over nine tensors with fixed binary signs, not arbitrary within-row group scales or full-sign QAT validation.
execution: Direct execution in current thread; delegated run cancelled at user request. No further delegation unless explicitly requested.
